# Young Icons Sports Academy

Young Icons Sports Academy is a Dubai-based kids sports academy running structured, coach-led programmes for children aged 3 to 14.

## Programmes
- Nursery Sports — for children from age 3, building movement, coordination, and confidence
- After-School Activity (ASA) — structured sessions delivered at Dubai schools, ages 5–14
- Holiday Camps — full and half-day sessions during school holiday periods, ages 3–14
- Multi-Sport Club — weekly sessions rotating across multiple sports
- Ballet Club — structured ballet classes for children

## Location
Dubai, UAE

## Booking
All programmes are bookable through Classcard. A free trial session is available.
